settings.animations.preview.tooltip: Click during the animation to reverse it
settings.animations.style.title: Animation style
settings.animations.style.modern.descrip: A smooth “lamp” curve from Potassiumuncher's engine, drawn on the graphics card.
settings.animations.style.classic.descri: The original funnel effect from the first version of the mod, fading out at the end.
settings.animations.style.scale.descript: The window shrinks into its taskbar icon in one smooth glide and melts away, like the scale effect of macOS.
settings.animations.duration.title: Duration
settings.animations.duration.description: How long a window takes to fall into the taskbar and to come back.
settings.animations.mesh.title: Mesh quality
settings.animations.mesh.description: More tiles make a smoother curve (modern style). On the graphics card the cost is negligible.
settings.animations.open.title: Opening
settings.animations.open.genie.descripti: The window flies out of the program's taskbar icon with the genie effect.
settings.animations.openDuration.title: Opening duration
settings.animations.openDuration.descrip: How long the opening animation of a window takes.
settings.animations.close.title: Closing
settings.animations.close.genie.descript: The window falls into its taskbar icon with the genie effect.
settings.animations.close.shatter.descri: The window breaks into pieces that fly off to the left, right, up and down, spinning as they fade away.
settings.animations.close.fragments.desc: The window breaks into a few big pieces that fly off in every direction, each its own way, and fade away.
settings.animations.open.shatter.descrip: Shards fly in from the left, right, top and bottom and snap together into the window.
settings.animations.open.fragments.descr: A few big pieces fly in from every direction and join into the window.
settings.animations.open.zoom.descriptio: The window grows out of the place you clicked, a touch past its size, and settles.
settings.animations.close.zoom.descripti: The window shrinks into the pointer (its close button, mostly) and fades away.
settings.animations.closeDuration.title: Closing duration
settings.animations.closeDuration.descri: How long the closing animation of a window takes.
settings.animations.openClose.note: Works in programs Lampwin has access to. With “Windows”, the window behaves as it would without Lampwin.
settings.animations.restore.title: Restoring windows
settings.animations.restore.description: The window flies out of the taskbar back to where it was.
settings.animations.multiMonitor.title: Multiple monitors
settings.animations.multiMonitor.descrip: Experimental: the genie goes to the taskbar on the window's monitor instead of the main one.
settings.animations.followSystem.title: Follow Windows' animation effects
settings.animations.followSystem.descrip: When Animation effects are off in Windows (Accessibility > Visual effects), windows open, close and minimize without Lampwin's animations.
settings.animations.energySaver.title: Follow the energy saver
settings.animations.energySaver.descript: While Windows' energy saver is on, windows open, close and minimize without animations, which saves battery.
settings.animations.unhide.title: Show the taskbar while minimizing
settings.animations.unhide.description: A hidden taskbar slides out so the window has somewhere to go.
settings.animations.unhideDuration.title: How long the taskbar stays visible
settings.animations.instant.note: Changes take effect immediately – there is nothing to save or restart.
settings.animations.notRunning: Lampwin is not running. Start it on the “General” page.
settings.corners.shape.title: Window corners
settings.corners.shape.description: macOS: a squircle with 100% smoothing, as in Figma. Windows 11: a plain rounded corner. Maximized and full-screen windows always have square corners.
settings.corners.radius.title: Corner radius
settings.corners.radius.description: At 100% scaling; Lampwin adjusts it to the display scale. 0 px means square corners.
settings.corners.genie.title: The settings window
settings.corners.genie.description: This window always has these corners. In the animations every window keeps the corners it has.
settings.corners.others.title: Other programs' windows
settings.corners.others.description: Programs that draw their own title bar: Chrome, Brave, Edge, Discord, VS Code, Spotify, Claude. Lampwin adds a shadow and a smoothed edge. Windows with the system title bar (File Explorer, Notepad) keep the Windows 11 corners – changing their shape breaks the frame.
settings.general.enabled.title: Animations on
settings.general.enabled.description: The main switch. Off means the standard Windows animations.
settings.general.autostart.title: Start with Windows
settings.general.autostart.description: Lampwin starts when you sign in and stays in the notification area.
settings.general.autostart.description.i: Lampwin starts when you sign in – with administrator rights, without a UAC prompt – and stays in the notification area.
settings.general.language.title: Language
settings.general.language.description: “Automatic” follows the Windows display language. Languages Lampwin doesn't have yet fall back to English.
settings.general.status.title: Status
settings.general.status.elevated: Running with administrator rights – programs started as administrator are animated too.
settings.general.status.normal: Running without administrator rights – programs started as administrator keep the standard animations.
settings.general.updates.check.title: Check for updates automatically
settings.general.updates.check.descripti: Once a day Lampwin asks GitHub whether a new version is out. Nothing else is sent.
settings.general.updates.auto.title: Install updates automatically
settings.general.updates.auto.descriptio: New versions are downloaded and installed in the background. When off, you get a notification and install with one click.
settings.general.updates.status.failed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
settings.general.updates.status.failedIn: The update couldn't be installed. Try again, or download it from the project's page on GitHub.
settings.general.updates.status.unusable: An update was found, but its files couldn't be used. Download it from the project's page on GitHub.
settings.general.updates.status.hostStop: Start Lampwin to check for updates.
settings.general.updates.prompt.title: Show new versions when the settings open
settings.general.updates.prompt.descript: Without automatic installs, this window tells you what changed in a new version and installs it with one click.
settings.update.title: Lampwin {0} is available
settings.update.subtitle: You have version {0}. Here's what's new:
settings.update.noNotes: This version came without release notes.
settings.general.transfer.title: Save or move your settings
settings.general.transfer.description: Keep them in a file, or take them to another PC. App icons are saved on the App icons page, as an icon set.
settings.general.transfer.imported: Your settings are in. The ones before are kept in settings.json.bak, in the settings folder.
settings.general.transfer.notSettings: This file doesn’t hold Lampwin settings. Choose a file made with Export.
settings.general.reset.title: Restore defaults
settings.general.reset.description: Animations, corners, updates and the programs left out go back to how they came. Widgets, app icons, privacy switches and the language stay.
settings.general.reset.confirm: Restore the default settings? Animations, corners, updates and the programs left out go back to how they came; widgets, app icons, privacy switches and the language stay. The current settings are kept in settings.json.bak.
settings.general.testMode.title: Only selected programs
settings.general.testMode.description: Lampwin works only in the programs on the list below. Turn it off to animate every program.
settings.general.footnote: Programs that were open before you changed this list must be closed and opened again. If anything misbehaves, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F12 turns Lampwin off immediately.
settings.exclusions.noAnimation.descript: Windows of these programs minimize with the standard Windows animation. Takes effect immediately.
settings.exclusions.noInject.description: Lampwin never enters these programs – for example games with anti-cheat protection that dislike foreign libraries. A folder works too, e.g. \steamapps\common\. Takes effect after the program is restarted.
settings.privacy.summary.title: Settings on this PC
settings.privacy.status.ready: The switches show what Windows does on this PC now.
settings.privacy.status.applied: Done. Some changes take effect after you restart Windows.
settings.privacy.status.restored: The original settings are back. Some take effect after you restart Windows.
settings.privacy.status.cancelled: The administrator prompt was cancelled. Nothing was changed.
settings.privacy.status.backupFailed: Lampwin couldn't read or save its backup, so it changed nothing. Details are in the log.
settings.privacy.status.failed: Not changed: {0} (left as it was). Details are in the log.
settings.privacy.restore.title: Undo Lampwin's changes
settings.privacy.restore.description: Puts back every Windows setting Lampwin changed, exactly as it was before.
settings.privacy.restore.none: Lampwin hasn't changed any Windows setting.
settings.privacy.restore.confirm: Put back every Windows setting Lampwin changed, exactly as it was before?
settings.privacy.footnote: A switch that is on means Windows does this. Turn switches off, then Apply. Settings for the whole PC need administrator rights: Windows asks once. Lampwin keeps a backup of everything it changes and never touches Windows Update, Microsoft Defender, SmartScreen or the firewall.
settings.privacy.telemetry.title: Optional diagnostic data
settings.privacy.telemetry.description: Off: Windows sends Microsoft only the required diagnostic data.
settings.privacy.diagTrack.title: Telemetry service
settings.privacy.diagTrack.description: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry, the service that sends diagnostic data.
settings.privacy.appCompat.title: Program compatibility telemetry
settings.privacy.appCompat.description: Windows records which programs you use and sends compatibility data.
settings.privacy.ceip.title: Customer Experience Improvement Program
settings.privacy.ceip.description: Scheduled tasks that collect usage, USB and disk data for Microsoft.
settings.privacy.errorReporting.title: Windows Error Reporting
settings.privacy.errorReporting.descript: Sends a report to Microsoft when a program crashes or stops responding.
settings.privacy.feedback.title: Feedback requests
settings.privacy.feedback.description: Windows asks you now and then what you think of it.
settings.privacy.typingData.title: Improve inking and typing
settings.privacy.typingData.description: Sends Microsoft samples of what you type and write by hand.
settings.privacy.adId.title: Advertising ID
settings.privacy.adId.description: Apps can show you personalized ads based on your activity.
settings.privacy.tailored.title: Tailored experiences
settings.privacy.tailored.description: Microsoft uses your diagnostic data for personalized tips, ads and recommendations.
settings.privacy.languageList.title: Language list for websites
settings.privacy.languageList.descriptio: Websites can read your language list to show content in your languages.
settings.privacy.appLaunches.title: Track app launches
settings.privacy.appLaunches.description: Windows remembers which apps you start to improve Start and search.
settings.privacy.inkingTyping.title: Personal inking and typing dictionary
settings.privacy.inkingTyping.descriptio: Windows learns words from your typing, handwriting and contacts.
settings.privacy.onlineSpeech.title: Online speech recognition
settings.privacy.onlineSpeech.descriptio: Your voice is sent to Microsoft's online speech service for dictation.
settings.privacy.startRecommendations.de: Start shows tips, shortcuts, new apps and promotions.
settings.privacy.accountNotifications.de: Start shows notifications and offers for your Microsoft account.
settings.privacy.settingsSuggestions.des: The Settings app shows suggested content and offers.
settings.privacy.tips.title: Tips and suggestions
settings.privacy.tips.description: Notifications with tips and suggestions for using Windows.
settings.privacy.welcome.title: Welcome screens after updates
settings.privacy.welcome.description: After updates, Windows shows what's new and ways to finish setting up.
settings.privacy.suggestedApps.title: Suggested apps
settings.privacy.suggestedApps.descripti: Windows installs promoted apps on its own and suggests apps in Start.
settings.privacy.lockScreenTips.title: Tips on the lock screen
settings.privacy.lockScreenTips.descript: Fun facts, tips and offers over the lock screen picture.
settings.privacy.explorerAds.title: Notifications in File Explorer
settings.privacy.explorerAds.description: File Explorer shows offers from sync providers such as OneDrive.
settings.privacy.webSearch.title: Web results in search
settings.privacy.webSearch.description: Search in Start also shows results from Bing. Off also hides recent searches in File Explorer.
settings.privacy.searchHighlights.title: Search highlights
settings.privacy.searchHighlights.descri: The search box shows trending searches and daily highlights.
settings.privacy.searchHistory.title: Search history on this PC
settings.privacy.searchHistory.descripti: Windows remembers your searches on this PC to improve the results.
settings.privacy.cloudSearch.title: Cloud content in search
settings.privacy.cloudSearch.description: Search shows content from your Microsoft, work or school account.
settings.privacy.activityHistory.title: Activity history
settings.privacy.activityHistory.descrip: Windows stores what you do in apps and on websites and can send it to Microsoft.
settings.privacy.copilot.title: Copilot
settings.privacy.copilot.description: Copilot in Windows and its taskbar button. To remove the Copilot app, uninstall it in Settings > Apps.
settings.privacy.recall.title: Recall
settings.privacy.recall.description: On Copilot+ PCs: saves snapshots of your screen so you can search them later.
settings.privacy.clickToDo.title: Click to Do
settings.privacy.clickToDo.description: On Copilot+ PCs: suggests AI actions for what is on your screen.
settings.privacy.windowsWidgets.title: Windows Widgets
settings.privacy.windowsWidgets.descript: The widgets board with news on the taskbar. Lampwin's own widgets are not affected.
settings.privacy.deliveryOptimization.de: Windows downloads updates from other PCs and shares them. Off: only from Microsoft.
settings.desktop.overview.title: Window overview
settings.desktop.overview.description: Every window on the screen side by side, like Exposé on a Mac. Click one to bring it to the front, or press Esc.
settings.desktop.overview.hotkey.title: Keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Alt+↑
settings.desktop.overview.hotkey.descrip: Shows the window overview from anywhere. You can also put it in a hot corner.
settings.desktop.corners.footnote: Push the pointer into a corner of the screen and hold it there for a moment. Corners do nothing while a game or a video runs full screen, or when you click in them.
settings.desktop.darkMode.title: Dark mode at night
settings.desktop.darkMode.description: Windows and your apps switch to dark mode in the evening and back to light mode in the morning.
settings.desktop.wallpaper.title: Day and night wallpaper
settings.desktop.wallpaper.description: The desktop shows one picture by day and another by night.
settings.desktop.schedule.title: When
settings.desktop.schedule.description: At sunrise and sunset where this PC is, or at times you choose.
settings.desktop.dayStart.title: Day starts at
settings.desktop.dayStart.description: Also used when Windows doesn't say where this PC is.
settings.desktop.nightStart.title: Night starts at
settings.desktop.appearance.footnote: Sunrise and sunset are worked out on this PC, from the place Windows location gives (or the place chosen for the Weather widget). Nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.tweaks.footnote: A switch that is on means Lampwin changes this Windows setting for you, the same way Windows Settings would. Turn switches on, then Apply. Nothing here needs administrator rights, and Restore puts everything back. Some changes show in the next File Explorer window you open.
settings.tweaks.status.ready: The switches show how Windows is set up on this PC now.
settings.tweaks.status.applied: Done. If something hasn't changed yet, it will after you sign out and back in.
settings.tweaks.status.restored: Windows' settings are back as they were.
settings.tweaks.restore.description: Puts back every setting this page changed, exactly as it was before.
settings.tweaks.restore.none: This page hasn't changed anything yet.
settings.tweaks.restore.confirm: Put back every setting this page changed, exactly as it was before?
settings.tweaks.showExtensions.title: Show file extensions
settings.tweaks.showExtensions.descripti: Shows the end of file names (.jpg, .exe, .pdf), so a file can't pretend to be something else.
settings.tweaks.showHidden.title: Show hidden files
settings.tweaks.showHidden.description: Shows the files and folders that Windows hides.
settings.tweaks.fullPath.title: Full folder path in the title
settings.tweaks.fullPath.description: File Explorer shows where a folder is, not just its name.
settings.tweaks.openThisPc.title: Open File Explorer to This PC
settings.tweaks.openThisPc.description: Your drives first, instead of Home with recent files.
settings.tweaks.compactView.title: Compact view
settings.tweaks.compactView.description: Less space between files in File Explorer, so more of them fit on the screen.
settings.tweaks.taskbarLeft.title: Taskbar icons on the left
settings.tweaks.taskbarLeft.description: The Start button and your apps sit at the left end, like in older Windows.
settings.tweaks.hideSearch.title: Hide the search box
settings.tweaks.hideSearch.description: Removes search from the taskbar. Press the Windows key and type to search.
settings.tweaks.hideTaskView.title: Hide the Task view button
settings.tweaks.clockSeconds.title: Seconds in the clock
settings.tweaks.clockSeconds.description: The clock on the taskbar shows seconds.
settings.tweaks.endTask.title: End task on the taskbar
settings.tweaks.endTask.description: Right-click an app on the taskbar to close it when it stops responding.
settings.tweaks.startMorePins.title: More pins in Start
settings.tweaks.startMorePins.descriptio: Start shows more of your pinned apps and fewer recommendations.
settings.welcome.title: Welcome to Lampwin
settings.welcome.subtitle: Pick a look to start with. You can change everything later.
settings.welcome.mac.title: Like a Mac
settings.welcome.mac.description: The genie everywhere, macOS corners, the window overview in the top-left corner of the screen and the desktop in the bottom-right one.
settings.welcome.calm.title: Calm
settings.welcome.calm.description: Short, soft animations and Windows 11's own corners.
settings.welcome.keep.title: Keep the defaults
settings.welcome.keep.description: The genie and macOS corners, nothing else changed.
settings.welcome.widgets: Put a clock and a calendar on the desktop
settings.list.dialog.title: Choose a program
settings.about.author: Created by {0}
settings.about.github.title: Source code
settings.about.github.description: Lampwin is open source. Stars, ideas and contributions are welcome.
settings.about.changelog.title: What's new
settings.about.reportBug.title: Report a problem
settings.about.reportBug.description: Describe what happened and attach the log – it helps a lot.
settings.about.license.title: License
settings.about.license.description: GNU GPL v3.0 or later. When you share Lampwin or a modified version, keep the author's name.
settings.about.genie.title: Genie animation
settings.about.genie.description: Based on the Windhawk mod “MacOS Minimize Animation” by Abdullah Masood, with Potassiumuncher's engine. MIT license.
settings.about.minhook.description: Function hooking library by Tsuda Kageyu. BSD 2-Clause license.
settings.about.log.title: Activity log
settings.about.log.description: What Lampwin does: animations, frame times, errors.
settings.about.folder.title: Settings folder
settings.about.folder.description: settings.json – the same things you change in this window.
settings.widgets.desktop.empty: No widgets yet. Click one above to put it on the desktop.
settings.widgets.notes.placeholder: Write your note here. The first line is its title.
settings.widgets.photo.dialog.title: Choose a photo
settings.widgets.countdown.placeholder: What are you counting down to?
settings.widgets.show.title: Show widgets on the desktop
settings.widgets.show.description: Drag a widget to move it. Right-click it to change its size or look.
settings.widgets.scale.title: Size
settings.widgets.scale.description: Makes every widget bigger or smaller.
settings.widgets.seconds.title: Second hand
settings.widgets.seconds.description: The clock ticks every second. Without it, it changes once a minute.
settings.widgets.location.title: Use my location
settings.widgets.location.description: The weather where this PC is, from Windows location services.
settings.widgets.location.denied: Windows doesn’t share the location with Lampwin. Turn it on in Windows, or choose a place below.
settings.widgets.location.unavailable: Windows couldn’t find the location just now. Until it can, the place below is used.
settings.widgets.location.rough: Windows only knows roughly where this PC is. For the right town, choose it below or set your default location in Windows.
settings.widgets.place.title: Place
settings.widgets.place.fallbackNone: Used when your location isn’t known
settings.widgets.place.error: The search didn't work. Check the internet connection.
settings.widgets.units.title: Temperature
settings.widgets.footnote: The weather comes from Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) and the town’s name from OpenStreetMap (nominatim.openstreetmap.org). While a Weather widget is on the desktop, Lampwin sends them the place’s coordinates, rounded to about a kilometre, every 30 minutes (OpenStreetMap only when the PC has moved); a search sends the name you type. Nothing else leaves your computer.
settings.icons.enabled.title: Custom app icons
settings.icons.enabled.description: Programs show the icons you choose below: on their windows, in Alt+Tab, on the taskbar and in the Start menu.
settings.icons.taskbar.title: Refresh the taskbar
settings.icons.taskbar.description: A pinned program keeps its old icon on the taskbar until File Explorer restarts. File Explorer's windows close for a moment; other programs stay open.
settings.icons.import.title: Add icons
settings.icons.import.description: Almost any image: macOS icons (.icns), PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, ICO, BMP, GIF, TIFF, or a program (.exe) to take its icon - or drag files and folders onto this page. They are cut to the size of other icons and each goes to the program its file name names; one that fits no program waits here until you choose one.
settings.icons.import.done: Icons added: {0}. Given to their programs: {1}.
settings.icons.empty: No icons yet. Add some with the buttons above: .icns, PNG, JPEG, WebP, ICO and other images.
settings.icons.status.free: Not used: choose a program from the list
settings.icons.footnote: Kept in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MacWin\icons. An open program gets its new icon right away. “No program” keeps the icon here and gives the program its own icon back, and so do removing an icon and turning this off.
settings.icons.sets.title: Icon sets
settings.icons.sets.description: Save your icons, and the program each one is for, in one file: as a backup, to switch between looks or to take them to another PC. Loading a set gives its icons to their programs; programs it has no icon for get their own back.
settings.icons.sets.loaded: Set loaded. Programs with an icon from it: {0}.
settings.icons.sets.invalid: This file is not a Lampwin icon set, or it can't be read.
settings.icons.match.title: Give icons by name
settings.icons.match.description: Every icon nobody uses yet goes to the program its name names, if that program is on this PC.
settings.icons.windows.title: Windows icons
settings.icons.windows.description: Every program gets its own icon back. Your icons stay in the list, to give them again whenever you like.
settings.icons.windows.done: Every program shows its own icon again.
settings.icons.removeAll.title: Remove all icons
settings.icons.removeAll.description: Deletes every icon in the list and gives every program its own icon back. The icons that come with Lampwin aren't added again.
settings.icons.removeAll.confirm: Delete all {0} icons? Every program gets its own icon back.
host.menu.testMode: Test mode (only programs on the list)
host.error.sharedSettings: Lampwin can't create its shared settings. If it was running with administrator rights a moment ago, sign out and sign in again.
host.error.renderer: Lampwin can't start its renderer (Direct3D 11 / DirectComposition). The details are in the log.
host.error.hookDll: Lampwin can't load MacWinHook64.dll. The details are in the log.
host.error.elevatedOutside:
Lampwin can run with administrator rights only from the Program Files folder (after installation). From this folder any program could replace MacWinHook64.dll and get into programs started as administrator.

Start Lampwin without administrator rights or install it with the installer.
host.alreadyRunning: Lampwin is already running (its icon is in the notification area).
host.update.available.title: Lampwin {0} is available
host.update.available.text: Click to see what's new and install it.
host.update.dialog.title: Lampwin update
host.update.dialog.heading: Lampwin {0} is available
host.update.dialog.text: You have version {0}. The update takes a few seconds and Lampwin restarts by itself.
host.update.failed: The update couldn't be downloaded or verified. Try again later or download it from GitHub.
host.update.done.title: Lampwin was updated to {0}
host.widgets.weather.noPlace: Choose a place for the weather in Lampwin settings.
host.widgets.weather.locationOff: Turn on location in Windows settings, or choose a place in Lampwin settings.
host.widgets.battery.title: Battery
host.widgets.network.title: Network
host.widgets.notes.empty: Write your note in Lampwin settings, under Widgets.
host.widgets.countdown.title: Countdown
host.widgets.countdown.empty: Choose its day in Lampwin settings, under Widgets.
host.widgets.nowPlaying.hint: Music and videos you play show up here.
host.widgets.photo.empty: Choose a photo in Lampwin settings.
